versions.changelog:
Initial release of douyin-searchs-pro: a tool for searching and analyzing trending Douyin (抖音) content.

- Supports keyword-based search of Douyin videos/posts, with sorting and filtering by likes, publish date, duration, and content type.
- Provides real-time hot search ranking and trending topics on Douyin.
- Enables bulk fetching of public works from specified Douyin creators.
- Allows structured analysis of video comments and interaction data.
- No login required; only requires a GUAIKEI_API_TOKEN for API access.
- Returns structured JSON for all outputs, suitable for further analysis and reporting.
